proposed_replacement.rationale: Python 3.11+ includes tomllib in the standard library (PEP 680), eliminating third-party unmaintained TOML dependencies.

validation.details: Module 'tomllib' verified in Python 3.12 standard library.

migration_steps.title: Replace imports in config loader
migration_steps.description: Change 'import toml' to 'import tomllib' in linkwatch/config.py.

migration_steps.title: Update toml.load call to binary file handle
migration_steps.description: tomllib.load requires a binary read mode file descriptor ('rb') rather than taking a string path.
migration_steps.diff_snippet:
-    data = toml.load(path)
+    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
+        data = tomllib.load(f)

migration_steps.title: Remove toml from requirements.txt and pyproject.toml
migration_steps.description: Remove toml==0.10.2 from requirements.txt and pyproject.toml dependencies.

suggested_tests.description: Verify that load_settings successfully parses sites.toml with tomllib and preserves all data keys.
suggested_tests.code_snippet:
def test_load_settings_tomllib(tmp_path):
    toml_file = tmp_path / 'sites.toml'
    toml_file.write_text('[linkwatch]\ntitle = "test"\n[[linkwatch.sites]]\nname = "example"\nurl = "https://example.com"', encoding='utf-8')
    from linkwatch.config import load_settings
    s = load_settings(str(toml_file))
    assert s.title == 'test'

compatibility_gaps.description: toml.load accepted a file path string or text handle. tomllib.load strictly requires a binary file handle opened with mode 'rb'.
compatibility_gaps.mitigation: Wrap the file reading with 'with open(path, "rb") as f: tomllib.load(f)'.

compatibility_gaps.description: tomllib is read-only and does not implement a dump() function.
compatibility_gaps.mitigation: Verified that codebase only performs reads (load), so write support is not required.

open_concerns_and_limitations.title: Minimum Python Version
open_concerns_and_limitations.description: tomllib requires Python >= 3.11. If backwards compatibility with Python 3.10 is required, tomli must be used as a conditional fallback.
